005package org.wpilib.math.autodiff;
006
007/**
008 * Expression type.
009 *
010 * <p>Used for autodiff caching.
011 */
012public enum ExpressionType {
013  /** There is no expression. */
014  NONE(0),
015  /** The expression is a constant. */
016  CONSTANT(1),
017  /** The expression is composed of linear and lower-order operators. */
018  LINEAR(2),
019  /** The expression is composed of quadratic and lower-order operators. */
020  QUADRATIC(3),
021  /** The expression is composed of nonlinear and lower-order operators. */
022  NONLINEAR(4);
023
024  /** ExpressionType value. */
025  public final int value;
026
027  ExpressionType(int value) {
028    this.value = value;
029  }
030
031  /**
032   * Converts integer to its corresponding enum value.
033   *
034   * @param x The integer.
035   * @return The enum value.
036   */
037  public static ExpressionType fromInt(int x) {
038    return switch (x) {
039      case 0 -> ExpressionType.NONE;
040      case 1 -> ExpressionType.CONSTANT;
041      case 2 -> ExpressionType.LINEAR;
042      case 3 -> ExpressionType.QUADRATIC;
043      case 4 -> ExpressionType.NONLINEAR;
044      default -> null;
045    };
046  }
047}
